description: This Java class 'SearchQueryAssert' provides custom assertions for testing instances of 'SearchQuery' in a testing framework, mainly for use with AssertJ. It includes methods to verify filters, sort options, limit options, and their string representations.

classes.name: SearchQueryAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for asserting properties of SearchQuery objects in test code.

methods.name: SearchQueryAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion object with the actual SearchQuery to be checked.

methods.name: hasFilter
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery has the specified SearchFilter.

methods.name: hasFilterString
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery's filter string matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasNoSortOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery does not have a SortOption.

methods.name: hasSortOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery has the specified SortOption.

methods.name: hasNoLimitOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery does not have a LimitOption.

methods.name: hasLimitOption
methods.description: Asserts that the SearchQuery has the specified LimitOption.

methods.name: hasOptionsString
methods.description: Asserts that the string representation of options in SearchQuery matches the expected string.
